# Waveform Analysis

## Summary
A precomputed amplitude envelope so a player can draw a waveform without decoding audio.

## Shape
`barsJson` holds the envelope and `barCount` its length; `algorithm` names the producer
(`rms-peak-v1` from a full decode, `mp3-side-info-v1` read from frame side info) so a consumer can
tell an old envelope from a new one when the algorithm changes. `decodeStatus` is `ok`, `skipped`
or `failed` with `decodeError` carrying the reason — a file whose audio would not decode records
that fact rather than silently having no waveform.

## Example
```ts
import { WaveformMetadataField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(WaveformMetadataField);
```
